keyEndpoints.purpose: Promotional event CMS, same shape as Admiral. Returns a 28-byte empty body for cagecode SVN — same size as the ADR control, so this brand has no CMS content. Not an odds source.

finding: Serves the same ncms.<brand>.ro/api/v1/event CMS shape as admiralbet, which suggested a new NSoft brand behind a new cagecode. Measured: cagecode=SVN returns a 28-byte empty body — byte-identical in size to the ADR control on the known-good Admiral CMS. The CMS is reachable but carries no content for this brand, so there is no companyUuid to harvest and no sports feed.
